verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's own pages say the card's FP8 Transformer Engine accelerates AI work across TensorFlow and PyTorch. Its CUDA Toolkit, NGC GPU-optimized containers and RAPIDS/cuML drop-in accelerators cover mainstream ML and data-science stacks, and a hands-on 4-card build reached 41k tok/s on an inference engine. However, nothing in the pack shows an official PyTorch build or support matrix naming this GPU. A community critic says the card's SM120 architecture lacks support in main libraries that target SM100/B300; this reflects uneven optimization rather than proof that frameworks fail to run. Missing for 10: an official PyTorch/TensorFlow support matrix listing the RTX PRO 6000 / SM120, documented framework builds for this GPU, and evidence of full library parity versus data-center Blackwell.
